original_heading: We Glory in the Resurrection of Christ, August 18
verse: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. John 11:25, 26.
title: The Living Power of Christ's Resurrection
bullets: Christ's resurrection conquered death itself, making Him the source of life for all who believe in Him.
Through His death and resurrection, Jesus united Himself with humanity so that we might share in His eternal life.
The risen Christ offers abundant life to every penitent soul who receives Him as their resurrection and their hope.

hymn.title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today

prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for rising from the grave and offering me the gift of eternal life through faith in You. Help me embrace the power of Your resurrection each day, knowing that in You I have both life and the promise of resurrection.
